info.author: district
info.name: core_bootstrap
info.description: Starts every project resource in the correct dependency order (core_shared -> core -> core_ui -> core_auth -> gm_voice -> gm_vehicles -> gm_vehicles_interaction -> gm_radio -> gm_blackout -> gm_scoreboard -> ui_hud -> gm_roleplay) on server boot, and restarts the whole chain when this resource itself is restarted (or via the /restartchain command). This is the only project resource that should be startup=1 in mtaserver.conf - see Bootstrap.lua's module comment.
